In this straightforward video, Dr. Rowe helps answer how long does it take for a lower back injury to heal and recover.

Discussed are minor issues, such as a strain of the lower back, to major issues like a lumbar disc herniation and sciatica pain. 

Also, Lower back pain relief stretches (as mentioned in the video) are shown that may help speed up recovery time: https://youtu.be/t1aA2JEaRpw
